_comment: GF group name → email recipients for the daily pre-trip email. Copy to recipients.json and fill in. Names must match the MyGeotab group name exactly (case-insensitive). A GF left out of this file falls back to a MyGeotab user whose first+last name equals the group name (user name must be an email), then to FALLBACK_TO. Shared groups like 'Brian Walch & Pete Schmit' can't be matched to a user, so list both emails here.
